segments.name: legal product offerings
segments.description: Sells cloud-native, AI-powered legal product offerings for legal hold, legal request, ediscovery, legal document review and case management to enterprises, law firms and governments.
segments.evidence: All of our revenue-generating activities directly relate to the sale and support of our legal product offerings within a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay monthly for their usage of the product offerings, or commit to a minimum data volume over a period under subscription contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Our usage-based revenue is derived from contracts under which customers are typically billed monthly based on their usage of our offerings.
